- Caesar salad w/ dressing: 72 g x 150 kcal/100g = 108 kcal (dressing-rich)
- Breaded fish: 105 g x 220 kcal/100g = 231 kcal

STEP 8 - Sanity check: a half-covered dinner plate with one salad mound and one fish fillet piece is plausible at ~180 g and ~350 kcal.
